comment: Authoritative shader build list. Every blob is compiled by the pinned DXC from tools/bootstrap-dxc.ps1 and embedded into the native binary. Raster and composite shaders are compiled with D3DCompile (SM 5.1) from embedded source so the base renderer never depends on DXC.

blobs.description: DXR static shadow library: ray generation, miss and closest hit
Mesh shader sample: per-instance meshlet culling
Mesh shader sample: emit meshlet vertices and triangles
Mesh shader sample pixel shader (same lighting as the raster path)
Compute probe: lighting reduction plus SM 6.6 heap-vs-table descriptor verification
